chats.answer:
Looking for a turntable (record player) with Bluetooth? There are several good options, depending on your budget and how you want to connect your speakers.

One important distinction:

Bluetooth output: Plays your vinyl records through Bluetooth speakers or headphones.

Bluetooth input: Lets you stream music from your phone to the turntable's built-in speakers.

If you want to listen to vinyl through wireless speakers, look for Bluetooth output.
